question: Can the cited 1989 Juliano, Guerrero, and Ronquillo chapter be retrieved from a legitimate public digital source, or does its catalog trail identify a physical acquisition route?

catalogFinding.repository: Philippine eLib / UP Diliman University Library
catalogFinding.title: Exotic aquatic organisms in Asia: proceedings of a workshop on introduction to exotic aquatic organisms in Asia
catalogFinding.physicalHolding: University of the Philippines Diliman, Marine Science Institute Library; call number SH 327.9 E85 1989; catalog location code MSI-543
catalogFinding.digitalCopyStatus: The public record explicitly says Digital Copy: Not Available.
catalogFinding.availabilityLimit: The catalog listing does not confirm current shelf availability, circulation conditions, or permission to scan.

nliCiNiiCatalog.finding: Bibliographic record for the same ISBN and 154-page volume; it lists three Japanese library holdings but no public full-text download in the record.

nusDigitalGems.screeningQuery: Public web-indexed title and author searches for the Juliano, Guerrero, and Ronquillo Philippines chapter.
nusDigitalGems.finding: The searches surfaced the adjacent 1989 Malaysia chapter (pp. 71–82) as an Open Access Digital Gems item, but did not surface the Philippines chapter (pp. 83–90). This is a bounded search result, not proof that NUS has no unindexed copy.
nusDigitalGems.reuseLimit: The sibling chapter's Open Access status does not apply to the Philippines chapter or establish its reuse terms.

fishbaseReference.finding: The bibliographic record confirms chapter title, authors, editor, volume, and pages 83–90, but its PDF/Reference URL field is blank.

repositoryScreen.excludedCopy: A third-party mirror of the copyrighted volume was not used as a source or downloaded because its authorization and reuse terms were not established.

secondarySource.title: Aliens from Aquariums
secondarySource.citation: Maini, Kumar, and Ragaza (2018), World Aquaculture 49(2), 59–63; relevant online pages 59–60 reviewed.
secondarySource.finding: Page 60 gives an aggregate statement that 62 freshwater fish species had been introduced since 1905, citing Juliano et al. (1989), Joshi (2006), and Guerrero (2014). Table 1 explicitly credits Guerrero (2014) and lists Monopterus albus origin as Malaysia and year as U (unknown).
secondarySource.interpretation: Secondary corroboration that the article-level 1905 period is broad and the 2014 table does not assign Monopterus a year; not an independent species-specific date or a substitute for reading the 1989 chapter.

libraryAccessRoute.finding: The official UP MSI Library page says the library accommodates the public and lists document delivery, interlibrary loan, scanning, and photocopying. UP Diliman lists fee-based document delivery for UP and non-UP users for materials held in UP Diliman Libraries.
libraryAccessRoute.nextStep: Ask the library to confirm whether the eLib-listed volume (SH 327.9 E85 1989, MSI-543) is currently available and whether pp. 83–90 can be consulted or supplied under its policies.
libraryAccessRoute.limits: Current shelf availability, document-delivery eligibility for this unit-library holding, fees, and copying terms are unconfirmed. No inquiry was sent.

evidenceLimits.chapterContent: No pages from the 1989 chapter were retrieved or read; no Monopterus-specific date or underlying citation can be verified from it. Maini et al. (2018) provides only secondary context: its aggregate since-1905 statement is not eel-specific, and its Table 1 is credited to Guerrero (2014), where the Monopterus year is unknown.
evidenceLimits.catalogScope: Catalog and repository search results establish discovery metadata and leads only, not the chapter's contents or current access rights.
evidenceLimits.reuse: The volume record and adjacent chapter do not establish item-specific permission to reproduce the target chapter, tables, or data.
evidenceLimits.acquisitionRoute: The official library pages document possible public, scanning, and fee-based document-delivery services, but do not confirm current availability of the specific volume or eligibility/permission to supply the target pages.

evidenceDecision.decision: No legitimate public digital copy of the Philippines chapter was found in the bounded search. A freely readable 2018 secondary article only supports an aggregate since-1905 period and reproduces a Guerrero (2014) table listing Monopterus year as unknown. The official UP MSI Library service page provides a possible public or document-delivery acquisition route for the eLib-listed physical holding, subject to confirmation. Keep the 1989 chapter unread and the species-specific 1905 date unresolved.

nextActions: If the chapter is still needed, ask the UP Diliman Marine Science Institute Library whether the eLib-listed copy (SH 327.9 E85 1989; MSI-543) is currently available for public consultation and whether a lawful document-delivery or scan request for pp. 83–90 is permitted; confirm any fee and reproduction conditions before requesting it.

If an authorized copy becomes available, review only pp. 83–90 and trace any species-specific introduction-year statements to their cited primary records; do not assume the aggregate 1905–1988 period applies to Monopterus.
Until the chapter is reviewed, keep the species-specific 1905 date and historical eel identity unresolved.
